szenen.text: While everyone talked about Nvidia's CEO scandal, three stories in the same three weeks got far less attention.
One: Paraguay seized Ueno Bank on November 3rd. About three million customers, sixty percent of all adults, could not withdraw or transfer their money.
Two: Binance lost 6.3 billion dollars, the biggest crypto heist ever. The FBI blames North Korea.
And here is the part that matters: Tether and Circle froze 2.37 billion dollars within a day. No judge. Courts only came later.
Three: Washington finalized the rules for the GENIUS Act. From January 18th, US banks can issue their own digital dollars.
Congress just flipped from red to blue. But this law passed with both parties, 68 to 30 in the Senate and 308 to 122 in the House.
Our view: a digital dollar isn't cash. It can be frozen with one click. That's what is coming on January 18th.
Safer money, or more control? Comment below and follow for what comes next.
